notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.content: [p]Two and a half years have passed. During this time, I learned many new things, discarded many things, and experienced things that came by themselves and things that did not last. Life is too complicated to describe in one post. I think you understand what I mean, especially with the release of the game.[/p][p]This game, like my journey, is not simple at all. But I am sure it will find its audience in any form.[/p][p]Adios! Thank you all, and I hope to see you again![/p]

notes.title: 0.3.0 UPDATE
notes.content: [h1]New:[/h1][p]- Research tree[/p][p]- New spawn of initial resources in the main location[/p][p]- Points for endless ore mining: iron, coal, copper[/p][p]- New materials: Coal, Copper, Zinc, Brass, Gear, Piston, Copper wire, Steel pipe[/p][p]- New buildings: Steam engine, Power line, Ore miners, crafting machines, turret, metal wall, tree farm[/p][p]- Skills and experience for NPCs[/p][p]- Electricity[/p][p][/p][h1]QoL:[/h1][p]- The nearest wall also becomes transparent inside the building[/p][p]- Crafting request[/p][p]- The ship is closer to the center of the location[/p]

notes.title: FIRST UPDATE!
notes.content:
Hello! It's meleiko, I'm here with a bunch of good news! You have to check it out! Let's go!

[h3]Here is what is in the new game update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now the main island always works in the background 
[*] Removed the points where the warriors run, now they automatically go to defend any building 
[*] Rescue of people now starts from the moment of opening the cell 
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Events, now events, arrivals of people, merchants, etc. can happen on the main island!
[*] Building has become more convenient, now you can choose several things at once for ore mining
[*] [b]NEW[/b]: Visual, the visual of the game has changed a lot 
[*] Optimisation, the game works up to 2 times faster!
[*] People should no longer get stuck in buildings 
[*] Fog removed from winter and boss locations
[/list]

[previewyoutube=s_q0dhbV264;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
It's been almost [i]six months[/i] since the last demo was released. 

In that time, I've added new mechanics, such as 
[list]
[*]Building mode
[*]NPC interactions
[*]Commands for execution
[/list]
You now can even make your own squad and go with them to defend you village! This and many other new features, along bug fixes are available now in demo. Try it out!

[b]Thank you all for your support![/b]

[i]P.s. Don't forget to write a review - it would really help me and development of the game![/i]
